transformations: Decode the palette PNG to RGB.

Uniform scale 800x600 -> 1200x900 (exactly 1.5x on both axes, no aspect rounding) with Pillow Image.Resampling.BOX. BOX was chosen after a side-by-side of NEAREST (uneven 1/2-px strokes in pixel text), LANCZOS (softer, faint ringing) and BOX (even, crisp strokes) on the Code and Properties windows.

Embed the scaled PNG as a data: URI in each variant SVG at x=347, y=90, width 1200, height 900 (1:1 device pixels), inside a 6 px #1b2027 mat and 2 px #343d48 stroke drawn entirely outside the image edges on the #111318 background.
clean-workspace: nothing else. five-callouts: annotation marks listed below, then labels in the margins.
No crop, rotation, stretch, retouch, colour change, dimming, zoom-in, watermark removal or partial use in either variant.
authored_additions: Labels: the five exact ticket-copy strings (manifest copy, SCRIPT.md:130), Liberation Sans Bold 40 px, #f1f3f5, in the side margins outside the screenshot and its frame. Multi-word labels are stacked one word per line; words, spelling and capitals are unchanged. Left margin (right-aligned, ending x=291): Toolbox, Form Designer, Code Window. Right margin (left-aligned from x=1603): Project Explorer, Properties Window.

Outlines: one per target, 5 px thick (1 px #111318 casing, 3 px #eab676 core, 1 px casing), drawn inside each target window's outer boundary so they cover only that window's outer frame bevel. The Form Designer outline follows the form window's visible top, left, right and bottom edges and stops 6 px short of the Code Window outline where the Code window covers the form.

Leaders: one per target, horizontal, 5 px thick with the same casing/core, from 14 px beyond the label to the target outline, on an original row that is desktop teal between the image edge and the target.
src/build.py, src/verify.py, src/finalize.py: deterministic authoring, pixel verification and delivery finishing.
